translationRepairs: The rulers of India and Maragha came to court.
The rulers of India and Mulahi came to court.
s0209 has 木羅夷國主; 木羅夷 is the Mulahi polity, not Maragha, so the proposed replacement is correct.
The rulers of India and Maragha came to court.
The rulers of India and Mulahi came to court.
The literal likewise misreads 木羅夷 as Maragha; Mulahi matches the Chinese.
In the sixth year (jiawu), in the first month of spring, the Jin emperor abdicated in favor of the clansman Chen Lin, then hanged himself and was burned.
In the sixth year (jiawu), in the first month of spring, the Jin emperor abdicated in favor of the clansman Chenglin, then hanged himself and was burned.
承麟 is Chenglin; Chen Lin invents a different name not supported by the Chinese.
When the city fell, Chen Lin was captured and killed.
When the city fell, Chenglin was captured and killed.
s0063 again names 承麟; Chenglin is the accurate reading, not Chen Lin.
That winter, in the tenth month, Yelü Ahai was put in charge of Han commoners' affairs.
That winter, in the tenth month, Yalavach was put in charge of Han commoners' affairs.
牙老瓦赤 is Yalavach; Yelü Ahai (耶律阿海) is a different person and unsupported here.
In the tenth month of winter, Yelü Ahai was ordered to supervise Han commoners' affairs.
In the tenth month of winter, Yalavach was ordered to supervise Han commoners' affairs.
The literal repeats the same wrong identity for 牙老瓦赤; Yalavach is correct.
Ma Bojian, Jin's garrison commander for Jincheng, surrendered; he was given a Jin tally of office and ordered to hold the place.
Ma Bojian, Jin's garrison defense controller, surrendered; he was given a golden tally of office and ordered to hold the place.
金防城提控 is Jin's city-defense controller office, not a Jincheng posting; 金符 is a golden tally, not a Jin-dynasty tally.
In the ninth month of autumn Prince Kökejin captured Song's Grand Marshal He.
In the ninth month of autumn Prince Köten Buqa captured Song's Grand Marshal He.
諸王口溫不花 is Köten Buqa (same Chinese used later in this chapter); Kökejin is unsupported.
